tailscale-android.description:
Tailscale is a free and open-source Android VPN client that makes it easy to securely connect your devices and private networks using WireGuard-based encrypted connections.

Create a private mesh network between your Android phone, computers, servers, NAS devices, and other supported systems without manually configuring traditional VPN servers, opening firewall ports, or managing complex network settings.

Features include secure remote access to devices on your tailnet, encrypted peer-to-peer connections, exit node support for routing internet traffic through another device, access to subnet-routed networks, and automatic connectivity across different networks.

Tailscale provides an intuitive Android interface for connecting to your private network, viewing connected devices, managing VPN connectivity, and selecting exit nodes.

Ideal for self-hosting enthusiasts, home labs, remote server administration, and secure access to private services while away from home.

The Android client is open source under the BSD 3-Clause license. A Tailscale account or compatible coordination service is required to establish and manage your private network.
